items.title: Test your applications against AWS locally with AWS Emulator
items.summary: AWS Emulator is a free, open-source local emulator in Rust that lets developers test applications against nearly every AWS service on their own machine using the same CLI and SDK commands, with fidelity measured against real AWS behavior.

items.title: Amazon S3 Tables now offer managed migration of Apache Hive tables to Apache Iceberg
items.summary: You can now migrate existing Apache Hive datasets in Amazon S3 to fully managed Apache Iceberg tables in Amazon S3 Tables, with no pipelines to build or compute to provision, while production workloads keep running.

items.title: Introducing Amazon ECS Gateway: A fully-managed ingress solution for ECS services
items.summary: Try Amazon ECS Gateway, a new account-level resource that simplifies ingress networking for containerized workloads by dynamically provisioning and managing the necessary infrastructure on your behalf, with all resources created directly in your account.

items.title: Announcing AWS Lambda Web Functions
items.summary: AWS Lambda Web Functions is a serverless compute primitive that runs your HTTP framework natively, delivering fast, consistent responses through multi-concurrent execution and automated global distribution.

items.title: Amazon S3 Tables now support all Apache Iceberg V3 data types
items.summary: Amazon S3 Tables now support all data types in the Apache Iceberg V3 spec, along with column default values, deletion vectors, and row lineage. Upgrade existing V2 tables or create new V3 tables with built-in compaction, maintenance, and engine compatibility.

items.title: Amazon S3 Vectors now supports metadata pre-filtering for higher recall on filtered searches
items.summary: Amazon S3 Vectors now supports metadata pre filtering, delivering up to 5x higher recall on filtered searches. Filters evaluate before similarity search so scoped queries return more relevant results. Ideal for RAG, agentic apps, and document search.
